list: The official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. GTA VI launches 19 November 2026, so steps marked 'inferred' are read from the official trophy description and published guide coverage, not confirmed in-game yet.
note: Official names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as published. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry. Sources are named beside each guide; they were consulted, never copied.

trophies.guide: This is the reward for earning the other 54 trophies, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup — and this unlocks last, automatically. PowerPyx puts the whole set at about 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10, so expect a long grind rather than a hard one. There are no online trophies, so everything can be done solo.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and finish it. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you learn the controls and meet the two leads. Nothing special is needed: just follow the mission prompts to the end. Inferred from the description — the mission name is the trophy's own requirement.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The story runs across five chapters and takes roughly 60 to 80 hours in total, according to PowerPyx, so this is simply the first fifth of that journey. Do the optional missions that appear along the way while they are available — they do not gate this trophy, but they feed the 100% checklist later. Cannot be missed; chapter trophies unlock on completion.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. By this point both protagonists are playable together, which matters for later activities such as meditating at every spot. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals with binoculars as you travel between missions — that progress counts toward the 100% checklist and saves a long cleanup later. Cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the midpoint of the five-chapter story, so by now you should be in the habit of doing side content as it appears: stranger missions, character quests and activities all stay available in free roam after the story, but doing them as you go spreads the work out. Cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. Before you push into the final mission, use a spare save slot — PowerPyx notes there is free roam after the story but no mission replay, so a separate save is cheap insurance for anything you want to revisit. Cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission to close the five-chapter campaign and earn one of only two gold trophies. There is no difficulty setting in the game, so no trophy asks for a harder mode — just complete the mission. After the credits, free roam opens up and the 100% completion checklist becomes visible under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Cannot be missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies like this one unlock by finishing that mission in the story flow — no extra objective is needed beyond reaching the mission's end. If a mission does not appear yet, keep playing the story until it is offered. Inferred from the description; the exact chapter is not stated in the trophy text.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in this game are story beats, so this unlocks by playing through the campaign rather than by setting anything up yourself. Keep a manual save before big story missions, since there is no mission replay after the story. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, this one follows the story: finish the mission and the trophy pops. If you are tracking the roadmap, tick it off as soon as it appears so you can see which story beats are still ahead. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. This is another story-beat trophy that unlocks on mission completion, with no side requirement hidden in the text. Play the campaign in order and it will come. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. The trophy's airport setting also hints at the later free-roam trophy tied to leaving VCIA in an unscheduled way, so remember the airport layout once you know it. Finish the mission and this unlocks. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a large set-piece mission late in the campaign; play the story through and finish it to unlock this. No extra condition is stated in the description. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Fill in the in-game 100% completion checklist, found under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion once the story is done — progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy, but notes the thresholds are lenient: it is closer to 60% of true completion, needing for example 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied, plus 70 of the 80 challenges. Nothing on the checklist is missable and everything can be done in free roam after the story. Leave this for last; most of it is finished by earning the other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime and similar driving feats, tracked as a running count. The practical way is to fold stunts into normal driving: take jumps and ramps whenever you see them instead of saving them for one grind session. PowerPyx counts this among the longest grinds, so start early and let the number climb while you do everything else. The count is cumulative, so nothing is lost by doing it slowly.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — the count reported in coverage is 9 types. Work through the activities list in the pause menu or the in-game phone and try each one: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them, just try each once. Do this early so the later activity trophies are already half understood. Inferred from the description; the exact list of 9 types comes from published trophy coverage.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Score gold on all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each challenge's target pattern and scoring, use the range's practice runs to find the rhythm, and take the challenges one weapon type at a time. It is one of only six silver trophies, so expect it to take a few focused sessions. If a challenge stalls, move on and come back fresh rather than burning out on it. Inferred from the description; the count of 42 comes from the official trophy tracking and published guides.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone racing is one of the activity types, so you will already know the controls from trying everything once. Visit each location on the map, win its race, and move on — the trophy tracks locations, not total wins, so a single win per spot is enough. Inferred from the description; the count of 14 locations comes from published trophy coverage.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types and locations: street races, drone races and any other race events the game offers. Winning needs a decent car and a clean line more than a perfect start, so retry a race you lost rather than grinding one you already won. The variety requirement is the point: keep a mental note of which races you have already won. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and beat him. Fishing is one of the game's activities — learn the casting and reeling rhythm in a casual session first, then take on Cal's challenge when you are comfortable with it. The trophy is about winning that one challenge, so the fish and the spot matter less than steady technique. Inferred from the description; Cal is named in the trophy text itself.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish a full run of any arcade game at an arcade location. Arcade games are quick, self-contained activities, so this is one of the easiest trophies: find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it through to the end. It does not ask for a high score or a win, just a completed game. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its last mission. Andy is one of the side characters whose quest line runs alongside the story; keep accepting his missions as they appear and follow them to the end. Side-character strands are separate from the main chapters, so check your contacts and map for his missions if none is showing. Cannot be missed — side missions stay available in free roam. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its last mission. Like Andy's strand, this is a side-character quest line: take each of Kenton's missions as it is offered and complete them in order until the finale. If his missions dry up for a while, play more of the story — new side missions unlock as the chapters advance. Cannot be missed. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its last mission. Work through Billy's quests as they appear, and this unlocks at the end of his line. Side-character finales are the backbone of roadmap stage 2, so do them after the story if you skipped any during it. Cannot be missed. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full Strangers & Freaks mission strands — the odd characters marked across Leonida, in the tradition of earlier games in the series. Each strand is a short quest line: meet the stranger, do their missions, and see it through to its end. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so you can pick the ones you enjoy; only completed strands count. PowerPyx puts this in the final cleanup stage, about 10 hours with the other side content. Cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its last mission. Randy is another side character with his own quest line; complete each of his missions as offered until the finale. If you are doing all side characters together, this fits naturally alongside Andy, Kenton, Billy and Tyrone. Cannot be missed. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its last mission. Work through Tyrone's quests in order and this unlocks at the end of his line. Side-character finales are unmissable, so do them whenever they are offered — or sweep them all up in free roam after the story. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. PowerPyx reports the first meditation is missable: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, follows her to the balcony, and choose Accept when offered. That first spot is reported as gone after Chapter 1, so do it the moment it is offered and do not leave the chapter without it. The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist. Treat every meditation prompt as unmissable-in-practice: accept it every time.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 achievements and trophies list

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Hunting is one of the game's activities: use the binoculars to study animals first — that study progress also feeds the 100% checklist, which asks for 100 of 255 animals studied — then take the shot when you find Bret's target. A unique animal is a one-off, so take your time lining up the hunt rather than rushing it. Inferred from the description; the animal-study counts come from PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish 3 complete sets of collectible cards found around Leonida. Cards are a collectible type: pick them up as you explore, and keep a note of which sets are nearly done so you can target the missing cards instead of wandering. Sets are completed by finding every card in that set, so this is a completionist trophy that rewards thorough exploring. Inferred from the description; the collectible framing comes from published trophy coverage.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app: point it at unfamiliar vehicles and places as you travel, and each new location counts. PowerPyx counts this among the longest grinds, so start scanning from the very first hour — every car and landmark you pass is a free point toward the 100. You do not need all 277 vehicles for the trophy, just 100 WAiNK locations. Cannot be missed; scanning stays available in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the game's challenges. Challenges are the small objectives tracked across activities — driving, shooting, exploring and more — and they stack up naturally while you play. PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80 challenges, so this trophy at 50 is a milestone on the way to that bigger number. Check the challenges list in the pause menu to see which ones are closest to done, and pick off the easy ones first. Cannot be missed.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. The trick is to earn the heat deliberately — cause chaos in a quiet area — and then break line of sight: duck into alleys, switch vehicles, or hide until the stars fade. Do it with your partner present, since the trophy names the partnership. Save first, because a failed escape just costs a retry. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route through three nearby shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving: the wanted level must stay active from the first shop to the third. A fast car parked outside each shop helps, and your partner needs to be with you for all three. Inferred from the description; the back-to-back reading follows the trophy text.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Find and discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Vehicles count as discovered when you encounter and scan or drive them — the WAiNK app is the natural tool, since scanning is how the game tracks what you have seen. The 100% checklist asks for 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, so this trophy at 100 is the halfway mark on a longer goal. Explore different areas, since rare vehicles cluster in different neighbourhoods. Inferred from the description; the 277 total comes from PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus — the slow-motion aiming mode — and take down 5 enemies before it ends. The practical setup is a firefight with a group of enemies close together: trigger Combat Focus, work through the group methodically, and do not waste time on a single tough target. If you only get 3 or 4, retry the same fight — the trophy counts one clean run of 5. Inferred from the description; Combat Focus is the game's name for the mode in the trophy text.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the trophy's joke is that you should not use a booked flight. In practice this means grabbing a plane at VCIA and taking off without going through the normal departure routine, or stealing an aircraft from the airport. Save before trying, since airport security will react. Inferred from the description; the exact method is not yet confirmed in-game, so try the plane-theft reading first.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This is the trophy tied to the Rhino tank: the description is a joke about how hot it gets inside one. Get into a Rhino tank — they appear at high wanted levels and at military areas — and use it. The trophy is a hidden one, so its exact trigger is not spelled out in the text; the natural reading is to drive or fight in a Rhino. Try driving one first, then using its cannon, and see which pops it. Inferred from the description; the precise trigger is unconfirmed and PowerPyx lists similar hidden trophies as not yet known.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly, without any detection. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, take the goods, and leave before an alarm is raised. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die down, and try again with a better approach. This is a stealth trophy, so patience beats speed. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank robberies are bigger jobs than shop robberies: plan the getaway before you go in, with a fast vehicle ready and a route away from the bank. Each vault counts once you escape cleanly, so five successful runs earn the silver. Spread them across the game rather than doing all five at once. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — find one on the road, stop it, take the cash, and get away before the police close in. A quick ambush in a quiet stretch of road works better than a long chase. One successful robbery and escape earns this. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida — the map tracks 52 areas in published coverage. Drive, fly and walk through each named region until the map shows it as explored; the easiest method is to work through the map region by region after the story, using a fast vehicle and the WAiNK app to log places as you go. Exploring also feeds the vehicle and location counts, so this pairs well with the WAiNK and discovery trophies. Inferred from the description; the 52-area count comes from published trophy coverage.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Gangs run their own illicit businesses around the map; find each gang's operation, rob it, and move on to the next gang's territory. The trophy tracks gangs, not total robberies, so one per gang is enough. Expect resistance — bring a good weapon and a getaway car. Inferred from the description; the 9-gang count comes from published trophy coverage.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find the spot with the view, and enjoy a cocktail there. This is a hidden, scenic trophy — a small moment rather than a challenge. Head to the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach, order a drink, and take in the view. PowerPyx lists this among the hidden trophies whose exact trigger was not yet known at launch, so the reading here is inferred from the description: the beach, the cocktail and the view are the three ingredients. Try the beachfront bar first.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's window and out the other side, in the classic style the trophy name winks at. Pick a showroom, line up a fast car, and smash through the glass — the point is the exit, not the car. PowerPyx lists this hidden trophy's exact trigger as not yet known, so this is inferred from the description; a showroom smash is the plain reading. Save first in case the first attempt does not register.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throw. Bowling is one of the activity types, so you will already know it from trying everything once. Head to that specific alley — not just any bowling lane — and complete a game there. The trophy is hidden, so the exact trigger is not spelled out; playing a full game at this named alley is the plain reading. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is about the partnership between the two leads reaching a wide audience — the description is deliberately vague, as hidden trophies are. The likely reading is a story or social-media moment where Jason and Lucia's partnership gains fame, so it probably unlocks through story progress or a specific duo activity. PowerPyx lists it among trophies not yet pinned down, so treat this as unconfirmed: keep playing the story and the duo activities, and it should come. Do not chase it early.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices in the game — the trophy text is a deliberate tease, and the tracker behind it reportedly counts choices up to 500. The reading is that this unlocks after making a certain number of decisions across the story and side content, so just play naturally and make choices when the game offers them instead of avoiding them. It is hidden, and PowerPyx does not pin down its exact threshold, so this is inferred from the description and the reported count. It should unlock through normal play.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something you failed first — the name says it all. The natural reading is to fail a mission, challenge or activity, then pass it on the immediate retry. If it does not pop on the first retry, try a different activity: the trophy is hidden and PowerPyx lists its exact trigger as not yet known, so this is inferred from the description. Do not force failures on story missions you care about; use a low-stakes challenge instead.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — this is the game's oddity trophy, for a weird random event or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. Hidden trophies like this one are deliberately cryptic, and PowerPyx lists its trigger as not yet known. The honest advice: explore off the beaten path, visit unusual places at odd hours, and keep an eye out for anything that does not fit. It will likely pop during thorough exploration rather than from a planned route. Inferred from the description; unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee drive-by — attack someone from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon — and knock them over. Drive slowly past a target on foot, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect. The trophy name is a bowling pun, so the target needs to go down, not just take a hit. PowerPyx lists this hidden trophy's trigger as not yet known, so the method is inferred from the description; try it on a lone pedestrian in a quiet street, and save first.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money earned from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big job instead of letting the bills pile up, and the total climbs steadily — $250,000 is a lot, so this is a late-game trophy that follows naturally from doing the robbery trophies. Check your contacts list after each heist to see who can launder. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food and everything else. This is cumulative spending, so it grows as you buy gear for other trophies: cars for racing, weapons for the shooting range, outfits along the way. If you are short near the end, buy an expensive vehicle or weapon to close the gap. It pairs naturally with the garage-properties trophy, since buying cars and garages both cost money. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages are properties you purchase to store vehicles; find each one on the map, visit it, and buy it. They cost money, so this pairs with the spending trophy — the garages themselves count toward the $100,000. Save up through heists and robberies, then buy them in a sweep once you can afford the lot. Inferred from the description; the 8-garage count comes from published trophy coverage.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery-style app. Drive or acquire 10 different vehicles, then register each one through the app on your phone. Any 10 vehicles count, so use the ones you already own or find on the street rather than buying new ones. This is a quick cleanup trophy once you know the app: grab ten cars, register them, done. Inferred from the description.
trophies.name: On the Spot
